title: Building a Shooter Game
author: WolfedUpLlama
selftext:
New here, I’m a Designer by trade for the last decade, I have some experience in 3D modeling and texturing. I have a background in development through school and odd ball projects which lead me to product development on iOS then AI became public and I shifted to Claude coding and me acting as a PM, Tester, Director role for my projects.

First, I am fully aware what I’m building is not at all original in concept, has the same tropes as Call of Duty but I’m okay with that because I’m really building it for fun and learning.

Project Salvo (Temp Name) stemmed from seeing all these posts online on how Claude can build a complete game in one prompt which I know just isn’t true.

I prompted roughly a paragraph of what I was looking for including it being multiplayer, separate client and server using Kenney visuals and the first pass was incredible and scary. From there I had it build custom guns and then objects.

From there I wanted to make sure that it was as full as I could get it to start and had Claude build out 18 maps, multiple weapons and attachments.

Play tested it but realized I needed admin tools so it developed a full admin panel that lets me see everything going on.

Further I noticed that there were bugs with some of the models and instead of prompting to fix things I had Claude build out custom tools specific for the game including a 3D modeling tool baked into the Admin panel that pushes updates live.

[Salvo.oddmens.com](http://salvo.oddomens.com) to try it out.

Note since this is a browser game and you are connecting to the server, I can see your IP (banning) and your device so if you want to use a VPN to feel more comfortable do it.

Prompt Time: 3 Hours  
Claude Running: 20 Hours (spent testing or coding)  
Time frame: 3 Days
